test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Fasting _______ some festivals increases the consumption of fruits.
solution:
The correct answer is **'during'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We use **'during'** to indicate when something happens in or over a period of time.

 
 
• Example- She swims
